title: Practice Data Platform Standard, Open Edition
description: A written standard and reference kit for data platforms at independent medical practices of fewer than 20 clinicians. It defines the conformed data entities, a catalogue of standard measures, nineteen data-quality tests with thresholds, a delivery and operating method, and four assessment baselines, so that the platform can be delivered by implementers other than its author and measured the same way at every practice. A reference implementation on Microsoft Fabric runs on synthetic data; the repository contains no real patient data. Open edition of the Firdavsystems LLC Practice Data Platform Reference Architecture and Implementation Package v1.1. Documents are licensed CC BY 4.0; code under Apache-2.0.
